page.overview:
Who is Alaric the Mad?

Alaric the Mad was an ancient Dwarf runesmith. He is famous for his many creations, and most of them are indeed among the most powerful artefacts in the mortal world, including the 12 Runefangs of the Empire of Man.

Alaric was known as "The Mad" by his fellow Dwarfs because he embarked on a quest to devise a new Master Rune, the Master Rune of Ages, resulting in the creation of the Nemesis Crown. He has been described as a flawed genius, obsessive and secretive even beyond the norm for Dwarf runesmiths.

Two and a half millennia ago, the Old World was a wild and benighted land. Savage beasts and fell beings haunted the forests and plains, and survival for the warring tribes of Men who dwelt there hung ever in the balance. It was into this savage world that Sigmar was born, and his first great deed was the rescue of the Dwarf High King Kurgan Ironbeard from a Greenskin raiding party. Ironbeard gifted Sigmar with a great runic warhammer -- Ghal Maraz -- with which Sigmar fought against the Greenskins, when he ultimately united the scattered tribes of Man. Years later, Sigmar and Kurgan stood together at the Battle of Black Fire Pass, and in recognition of their great victory, Kurgan ordered his Master runesmith to forge the Runefangs.

That Master runesmith was Alaric, creator of some of the greatest weapons ever wielded in battle. To begin with, Alaric captured the last eddies of a magical storm. Through potent runes, Alaric bound those vast energies into molten metal and began to make the twelve Runefangs. A century in the making, the Runefangs were gifted to each of the Empire's Elector Counts. Some say that the century Alaric spent toiling at his forge drove the runesmith to obsession and paranoia. His peers considered the Runefangs Alaric's greatest achievement, but the runesmith himself refused to accept that he had reached the height of his art.
